annotations.title: Extract the text of one PDF (paid, x402)

description: PAID: extract text from a PDF, page by page (up to 20 pages), for $0.0100. We fetch it; no OCR. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

maxPages.description: Return at most this many pages: 1..20. Omitted means 20.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the PDF, e.g. https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v7.
